issue.body:
This PR does the following:
- support for the parser specific properties directly in the application.properties
- it temporarily uses the reflection code in the build phase to find the type of the parameter due to `TikaConfig` in Apache Tika not currently able to load the configuration with out the type attributes; it will be gone soon enough I hope

This is the final PR I'd like to merge to the Tika extension code before 0.24.0/1.0 and would only follow up with a simple user guide demo which is mostly ready
